title: CarHub
tagline: Nigeria’s marketplace for verified cars: three products in one.
summary: Reserve a car online with a refundable deposit, inspect it in person, then pay the balance. CarHub also sells parts and accessories that fit your car, and books rides and chauffeurs tracked live on a map.
problem: Buying a car online in Nigeria usually means scrolling through unverified listings, then wiring money to a stranger. Nobody pays ₦50M by card for a car they haven’t seen, so CarHub models how the purchase really works.
note: Portfolio project: listings, dealers and reviews are demo data and no real vehicles are sold. Free hosting, so the first visit can take 30–50 seconds to wake.

parts.name: Cars marketplace
parts.about: Every listing is reviewed before it goes live and every price is compared with the market. Buyers reserve with a refundable ₦250,000 deposit, the seller confirms an inspection slot, and the buyer pays the balance or cancels for a refund.
features: Filters for make, body, fuel, price, year, mileage and state
A price badge that compares each car with the market
Checkout locks the car, so two buyers can never reserve one car
Each car in an order has its own status, notification and email
Public seller storefronts with ratings and reviews
shots: Home page with the featured-car spotlight
Browse with filters and price badges
Car page with the price insight

parts.name: CAS · Car accessories & parts
parts.about: Buyers save their car once, and every product shows “Fits your Camry” or “Doesn’t fit”. Approved vendors manage stock and fulfil orders.
features: Fit check on every product for your saved car
One switch shows only parts that fit
Live stock; stock rows are locked so items can’t be oversold
Paystack, demo payment, or pay on delivery in Lagos and Abuja
Delivery priced by state, free over ₦100,000
shots: The parts store, shopping for your car
Product page with the fit check

parts.name: DriverZone · Rides & chauffeurs
parts.about: Book a ride, or a vetted chauffeur to drive your own car by the hour or day. Drivers share live GPS from their phone, and every trip is tracked live.
features: Search any address (Photon), or drop pins; routes on real roads (OSRM)
Ride (Economy or Comfort) and Chauffeur, up to 30 days ahead
Dispatch to the nearest idle, verified driver
Fares recomputed on the server, never trusted from the browser
Live updates over WebSockets, with a polling fallback
A live operations map for staff

extra: Staff console: everything public is checked first
why: Buying a car online in Nigeria usually means scrolling unverified listings, then wiring money to a stranger. I built CarHub to follow how a car sale really happens (reserve, inspect, then pay) and to prove I can ship a complete marketplace: buyers, sellers, vendors, drivers and staff in one product.
hard: Checkout locks the car rows inside a transaction, so a second buyer is told the car has just gone. Nobody is charged for a car that is already taken.
Every status change is pushed over WebSockets the moment it is committed; if the socket drops, the page reconnects with backoff and falls back to polling.
Ride fares are always recomputed on the server from the real road route, never trusted from the browser.
Each product is matched against the buyer’s saved make, model and year, and stock rows are locked so nothing is oversold.
